name: tt_math_x
cmd: export HF_HOME=/scratch1/$USER/mechflow/hf_home HF_HUB_CACHE=/scratch1/$USER/mechflow/hf_home/hub H2N_REGIME=MR PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID=0 SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_COUNT=1 && /scratch1/$USER/mechflow/env/bin/python runner.py --tasks tasks_tt_math_explore.jsonl --job jobs_h2n:h2n_task --out results/tt_math_explore --workers-per-gpu 2 --dtype bf16 && test $(cat results/tt_math_explore/shard_*.jsonl | wc -l) -ge 100 && touch results/tt_math_explore/DONE

name: tt_code_x
